tasks.task: Scaffold Node.js/Express server with SQLite database initialization
tasks.description: Create the foundational project skeleton: package.json with express, better-sqlite3, dotenv dependencies and start/dev scripts; src/server.js Express entry point serving static files from public/, exposing GET /api/health, and listening on PORT; src/db/db.js initializing a better-sqlite3 connection to DB_PATH and creating the todos table (id, text, completed, created_at) if it does not exist; .env.example documenting PORT and DB_PATH; .gitignore excluding node_modules, .env, and the sqlite db file. Establishes shared infrastructure for the Todo CRUD feature.
acceptance_criteria: npm install succeeds and installs express, better-sqlite3, dotenv
npm start launches the server without errors listening on PORT (default 3000)
GET /api/health returns HTTP 200 with a JSON status body
SQLite file at DB_PATH is created on startup with a todos table containing id, text, completed, created_at columns
.env.example documents PORT and DB_PATH with example values

tasks.task: Implement full to-do tracking — model, service, API endpoints, and UI
tasks.description: Build the complete vertical slice for to-do management: src/models/todoModel.js (getAll, create, toggleComplete, remove against the todos table); src/services/todoService.js wrapping the model with validation; src/routes/todoRoutes.js exposing GET/POST /api/todos and PATCH/DELETE /api/todos/:id; modify src/server.js to mount the router at /api/todos; public/index.html, public/style.css, public/app.js implementing a vanilla JS frontend that lists, adds, toggles, and deletes todos via fetch calls without full page reloads. Optionally update README.md with usage instructions.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/todos with {text} returns 201 with created todo object and persists it in SQLite
GET /api/todos returns 200 with an array of persisted todo items
PATCH /api/todos/:id toggles completed and returns 200 with updated object; 404 for non-existent id
DELETE /api/todos/:id removes the row and returns 204; 404 for non-existent id
index.html loads and displays existing todos on page load via fetch
Adding a todo via the UI form updates the list without a full page reload
Toggling a todo's checkbox updates completed state visually (e.g., strikethrough) via PATCH
Deleting a todo via the UI removes it from the list via DELETE
